#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a simple cover page PDF with title and date (pure Python, no deps)."""

def esc(s):
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        o = ord(ch)
        if ch in '()\\':
            out.append('\\' + ch)
        elif 32 <= o < 127:
            out.append(ch)
        else:
            out.append('\\%03o' % o)
    return ''.join(out)

title = "Annual Financial Report"
date_str = "2026-08-01"

# Content stream (letter size 612x792). Positions pre-computed to approximate centering.
content = f"""BT
/F1 40 Tf
0.10 0.20 0.45 rg
89 500 Td
({esc(title)}) Tj
0 -70 Td
/F1 18 Tf
0 0 0 rg
266 0 Td
({esc(date_str)}) Tj
ET
"""

objects = []
# 1: Catalog
objects.append(b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
# 2: Pages tree
objects.append(b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>")
# 3: Page
objects.append(b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>")
# 4: Contents stream
stream = content.encode('latin-1')
objects.append(b"<< /Length " + str(len(stream)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" + stream + b"\nendstream")
# 5: Font (standard Type1 Helvetica)
objects.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")

pdf = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
offsets = [0]
for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
    offsets.append(len(pdf))
    pdf.extend(f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode())
    pdf.extend(obj)
    pdf.extend(b"\nendobj\n")

xref_pos = len(pdf)
pdf.extend(f"xref\n0 {len(objects)+1}\n".encode())
pdf.extend(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
for off in offsets[1:]:
    pdf.extend(f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode())
pdf.extend(f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects)+1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode())

with open("cover_page.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(pdf)
print("created cover_page.pdf")
PYEOF
